Team,

I reviewed the sample remit rows and ran a reconciliation pass against the April settlements. Findings:
- 12 of the 18 remits map cleanly to invoice sets and VAT allocation is derivable from our settlement payload.
- 6 remits have mixed-country invoice lines where Acme's posting wants VAT at invoice-line granularity; our current payload only reports VAT at remit-level for legacy flows.

Proposed options (pick one):
A) Run a one-time journal sweep to allocate the 6 remits to the correct VAT buckets using manual line splits (Finance will produce JV csv).
B) Provide Acme with a per-invoice VAT reconstruction table and ask them to re-run matchback (preferred long-term if they can ingest the file).
C) Implement a small export change (2 days engineering effort) to include invoice-line VAT in settlement payloads for future remits.

If Acme needs an immediate fix for month close, I recommend option A + we provide the JV template. If this is a recurring issue with their ERP settings, option B + C is the right path.

I'll prepare the JV template this morning and send to Maya if we decide A.

Ben Carter
